Asset type: transparent PNG inventory item icon for a top-down academic conference pixel RPG.
Primary request: Create a small teal portable solid-state drive with a short neatly coiled cable and a brass connector, clearly recognizable as a compact data storage item.
Subject: One isolated centered portable SSD and its short coiled cable with brass connector; keep the silhouette simple and readable.

Scene/backdrop: Genuine transparent background only; no ground, room, pedestal, glow, or vignette.
Constraints: No lettering, text, numbers, labels, brands, logos, or watermark.
